cases.case: the preview is the target minus the cutters
cases.input: Boolean=On with a selected metal body
cases.expect: session.cut holds a closed result; the document is unchanged until Enter

cases.case: the cut is committed with its record
cases.expect: the metal body geometry is replaced, om9.cutter.cut records removed_mm3/applied/preserve, no Gem Cutter body is inserted

cases.case: Boolean=One cuts the first cutter only
cases.expect: applied == 1 and the removed volume is not larger than the full cut
the metal body and the cutter bodies return to the pre-command state
